Privacy Policy

How Best of the City Awards collects, uses and protects the information you share with us.

Effective November 13, 2026

Best of the City Awards (“Best of the City Awards,” “we,” “us” or “our”) runs a local business recognition program, including nominations, community voting, business spotlights and optional media packages. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit bestofthecityawards.com (the “Site”), fill out one of our forms, text or email with us, or otherwise take part in the program, and how we use and protect it.

By using the Site or submitting information to us, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site.

Information we collect

Information you give us

When you apply for a Free Business Spotlight, nominate a business, contact us or otherwise reach out, we may collect:

  • Your name, email address and phone number
  • Business details, such as business name, city, state, website or social media pages, type of business and anything you tell us about it
  • Details about a business you nominate, and your relationship to it
  • The content of your messages, and your text message and email preferences
  • Interviews, photos, video and other content you provide or agree to have recorded for a spotlight or media package

Information collected automatically

When you visit the Site, we and our service providers may automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, referring pages and the date and time of your visit, using cookies and similar technologies. See Cookies and similar technologies below.

How we use your information

  • To review applications and nominations, schedule interviews and run the awards and spotlight program
  • To produce and publish business spotlights, articles and videos
  • To respond to your questions and requests
  • To send you text messages and emails you have agreed to receive (see Text messaging below)
  • To tell you about program news, events and optional services, where you have agreed to hear from us
  • To keep voting and the program fair, secure and free of fraud or abuse
  • To understand how the Site is used and improve it
  • To comply with the law and enforce our Terms of Service

Text messaging (SMS)

If you check a consent box on one of our forms, you agree to receive text messages from Best of the City Awards at the phone number you provided. There are two separate, optional consents:

  • Non-marketing messages about your spotlight application, nomination or the program, such as scheduling and status updates.
  • Marketing messages, such as program news and special offers.

Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of any purchase or of taking part in the program. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to stop receiving messages, or HELP for help. You can also contact us at hi@bestofthecityawards.com or (928) 549-8006.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third parties, except service providers that help us deliver our messages.

How we share information

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in these situations:

  • Published spotlight content. If your business is featured, the business information, interview, photos and video you agreed to share are published on the Site, YouTube and our social media channels.
  • Service providers. Companies that help us run the program, such as our website, form, CRM, email and text messaging platforms, hosting and video providers. They may use your information only to provide services to us.
  • Program partners, at your request. If you ask to learn about a partner benefit offered to participating businesses, we may share your business contact details with that partner so they can respond to you.
  • Legal and safety reasons. When required by law, or to protect the rights, property or safety of Best of the City Awards, our users or others.
  • Business transfers. As part of a merger, acquisition or sale of all or part of our business, in which case this Privacy Policy will continue to apply to your information.

Cookies and similar technologies

The Site uses cookies and similar technologies to make forms work, remember preferences and understand how visitors use the Site. Embedded content from other sites, such as YouTube videos and Google Fonts, may also set cookies or collect data under those companies’ own privacy policies. We embed YouTube videos in privacy-enhanced mode where available. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, though some parts of the Site may not work properly without them.

Your choices

  • Text messages: reply STOP to any message to opt out.
  • Emails: use the unsubscribe link in any marketing email, or email us.
  • Access, correction and deletion: you can ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, by emailing hi@bestofthecityawards.com. We may need to keep some information to meet legal obligations or resolve disputes.
  • Published spotlights: if you would like a published spotlight about your business changed or removed, contact us and we will work with you.

Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under local privacy laws. We will honor requests as the law requires.

How long we keep information

We keep personal information for as long as we need it for the purposes described in this policy, such as running the program and keeping records of consent, unless a longer period is required or allowed by law. Published spotlight content stays on the Site as a permanent feature unless you ask us to change or remove it.

Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Children’s privacy

The Site and program are intended for adults and businesses. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

Links to other sites

The Site links to other websites, such as featured businesses, YouTube and social media. We are not responsible for their privacy practices, so please review their policies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the effective date at the top of this page. Your continued use of the Site after an update means you accept the revised policy.
